<noinclude>
==Usage==
===Empty Syntax===
<pre>
{{Image
| License                 = 
| ImageType1              = 
| ImageType2              =
| ImageType3              =
| Description             = 
| Source                  =
| Artist                  = 
| Artist2                 = 
| Artist3                 = 
| AI                      = 
}}</pre>
===Value descriptions===
<pre>
| License                 = OPTIONS : Creative Commons, GFDL, Public Domain, Public Domain Self, Fairuse 
| ImageType1              = OPTIONS : Character, Chapter Art, Fan Art, Item, Map, Miscellaneous, Movie Posters, Movie Screenshots, 
                                      User, Logo, Video Game Screenshots, CCG, Administrative
| ImageType2              = SAME AS IMAGETYPE1 (NOT REQUIRED)
| ImageType3              = SAME AS IMAGETYPE1 (NOT REQUIRED)
| Description             = BRIEF DESCRIPTION / SUMMARY OF IMAGE

| Source                  = SOURCE WHERE IMAGE WAS OBTAINED. (EITHER OFFLINE OR ONLINE)
| Artist                  = NAME OF ARTIST (LEAVE "Artist =" IN TEMPLATE IF NO ARTIST IS KNOWN)
| Artist2                 =                (IF AI, PUT PROMPTER'S NAME)
| Artist3                 = 
| AI                      = NAME/VERSION OF AI MODEL USED TO PRODUCE IMAGE or "AI" IF SPECIFIC MODEL UNKNOWN
</pre>
===Example===
{{Image
| License                 = Public Domain
| ImageType1              = character
| Description             = Lorem ipsum
| Source                  = The ether
| Artist                  = Poser
| Artist2                 = John Doe
| Artist3                 = Jane Doe
| AI                      = AI
}}
[[Category:Image templates|{{PAGENAME}}]]
</noinclude>
